note: Sizes of the new app's code in next/dist, squeezed (gzip), in bytes. next/test/budgets.test.js holds the build to them. Stage 0 set firstLoad, anyChunk and total. Stage 1 added parts (every shared part with what it imports, about 25 KB at stage 1, room left for the lines later screens add) and css (tokens plus parts, about 7 KB). Stage 2 added route (each screen the shell loads by its address, with what it loads that the first load hasn't, about 3 KB for Home at stage 2; the marking and lesson screens will be the large ones). An increase needs Taylor's explicit approval. Stage 5 added heic (720 KB): the iPhone photo decoder, the one chunk allowed over anyChunk (Taylor, 18 Nov 2026), fetched only when an HEIC picture is read. Each language's area chunks, including the shared loader and unpacker, must fit langFile (120,000 gzip bytes). The total counts the app plus its largest language, since a teacher downloads only the language they choose. The current app's budgets (6.5 MB index.html, 800 KB languages) are separate and unchanged.
